Dar Global Expands Saudi Arabia Portfolio with New Jeddah Development Valued at SAR 1 Billion 16/11/2026 Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia Dar Global, the London-listed international luxury real estate developer, today announced plans for a new mixed-use development in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, with an estimated gross development value (GDV) of approximately SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million). The project will be developed on land acquired for a consideration of approximately USD 56 million, further strengthening Dar Global's presence in one of Saudi Arabia's key real estate markets. The acquisition forms part of Dar Global's programme to expand its Saudi Arabia portfolio by up to SAR 4 billion, and further land acquisitions will be announced shortly. On completion of the programme, the company's global development pipeline is expected to reach approximately USD 24 billion. The development is also set to introduce a new international luxury brand to Jeddah through an exclusive co-branded residential concept, further strengthening the city's luxury real estate offering. The expansion follows strong market demand for Dar Global's existing developments in Jeddah, including Trump Plaza and Padel Living, reflecting sustained appetite for high-quality, master-crafted residential and mixed-use developments among both local buyers and foreign investors taking advantage of the new property ownership laws. Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate (Dar Global, press)
Dar Global Capital Partners Targets High-Value Real Estate Opportunities in Dubai Across Global Investment Mandate 26/10/2026 Dubai, United Arab Emirates Dar Global Capital Partners (DGCP), the alternative asset management arm of London-listed luxury international developer Dar Global, today announced its strategic focus on deploying capital across international real estate markets through a dedicated cross-border mandate spanning the GCC, Europe, the United Kingdom, and the United States, alongside high-conviction investments in Dubai. Operating independently from the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) under regulatory oversight by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (DFSA), DGCP connects global private wealth and institutional capital with prime real estate assets. As part of this cross-border mandate, and with Dubai continuing to attract sustained international capital inflows as a premier wealth and business hub, DGCP is exploring the potential for a dedicated Dubai-focused real estate opportunities fund. The firm’s investment framework across all target markets is anchored in institutional discipline, prioritizing attractive entry valuations, rigorous structural downside protection, and active value creation through strategic asset repositioning and operational enhancements. In parallel, DGCP announced the appointment of Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of Dar Global PLC, as Chairman of DGCP, reinforcing governance and alignment between the parent group’s international development footprint and the asset management platform. The appointment follows a transformational phase for Dar Global, which recently upgraded

Dar Global Opens Sales for Trump Villas Simaisma, Qatar with Unprecedented Interest 07/10/2026 Doha, Qatar Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, has officially opened sales for its Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma, Qatar, witnessing unprecedented demand and strong investor interest since sales launched on 1 October. The limited release includes three- and five-bedroom Trump Villas, each offering the privacy of a gated community, along with elevated views of the expansive 18-hole golf course, Simaisma beach and the open sea. Residences are now available to purchase, with prices starting from QAR 5 million. Works on site are expected to begin in early 2027, with completion targeted for the end of 2030. Designed to deliver an exclusive coastal lifestyle, the development will be Doha’s first gated golf community, comprising a limited number of villas. It will feature a dedicated community centre for residents, equipped with padel and tennis courts, alongside a members-only golf and beach club, one of a kind worldwide. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, commented: “The advancement of Trump International Simaisma, Qatar, marks a key milestone in delivering high-value, iconically branded real estate in premier regional growth markets. Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln 30/09/2026 Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million). The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK. Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%). EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million). Growth was primarily anchored by revenue recognition from landmark projects, including The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin and Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad. The Group’s Gross Development Value (GDV) nearly doubled year-on-year to reach US$23.0 billion, reflecting rapid portfolio expansion. Cumulative contracted sales rose to US$3.9 billion across 4,380 units. Dar Global maintained a robust balance sheet with a Net Asset Value of US$613.3 million and total cash balances of US$847.9 million (comprising US$231.6 million free cash and US$616.3 million restricted escrow), supporting total available liquidity of US$579.3 million. Dar Global and Fendi Casa announce Azure Oceanfront Villas in Oman 29/06/2026 Muscat, Oman Dar Global and FENDI Casa announce the launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, a collection of ultra-luxury mansions with interiors by FENDI Casa, set within the prestigious AIDA clifftop community in Muscat, Oman. Conceived by Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate company, AIDA is one of the most expansive and exclusive mixed-use real estate developments globally. The launch unveils 19 thoughtfully designed and exquisitely appointed mansions with direct beach access featuring FENDI Casa's signature Italian craftsmanship and refined high-end design to AIDA, a magnificent, gated community built on a 130-metre-high cliff, surrounded by rocky canyons, pristine beaches, and the scenic Oman coastline. Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global, said: “The launch of Azure Oceanfront Villas, Interiors by FENDI Casa, at AIDA reflects Dar Global’s commitment to identifying and unlocking high-value real estate opportunities in growth markets. Oman’s luxury property sector is at a turning point, fuelled by investor appetite for branded residences and government initiatives driving inbound investment. Our partnership with FENDI Casa brings world-renowned Italian design to this vision, elevating the standard of upscale living in Muscat. Together, we are further elevating the position of AIDA as a strategic gateway for global investors seeking long-term value, lifestyle returns, and design-led distinction in the region.”

Darglobal plc secured this USD 250 million financing as part of its continued growth and expansion across key global markets. Emirates NBD Capital acted as the Joint Mandated Lead Arranger, Bookrunner and Sole Documentation Agent to execute the USD 250 million deal. The financing will support Darglobal's global expansion plans, enabling the leading real estate developer to accelerate existing projects and pursue new property developments across key markets. This financing highlights Emirates NBD’s structuring and distribution capabilities in the syndicated finance space, reinforcing its role as a trusted partner to regional and international real estate developers amid sustained momentum in global property markets. Ahmed Al Qassim, Group Head of Wholesale Banking at Emirates NBD, said: "This transaction reinforces the confidence global institutions place in Emirates NBD's ability to originate and execute large-scale syndicated financings. The strong participation from a broad group of lenders reflects deep distribution across our network and continued appetite for real estate-linked credit.

Five Types of Insurance Coverage Every Homeowner Needs Owning a home is a significant achievement and a substantial investment that necessitates protection. As a homeowner, it’s crucial to understand the various types of insurance coverage available to safeguard your property and finances. Here are five essential types of insurance coverage every homeowner should consider: 1. Homeowners Insurance This is the most fundamental and necessary form of insurance for homeowners. It covers the structure of your home, your personal belongings, and liability protection in case someone is injured on your property. Homeowners insurance typically covers damage from fires, storms, theft, and other common hazards. However, it’s important to read the fine print, as certain natural disasters like floods and earthquakes are often not covered. 2. Flood Insurance Standard homeowners insurance policies do not cover flood damage. If your home is in a flood-prone area, flood insurance is indispensable. This insurance covers damage to your home’s structure and belongings due to flooding. The National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) and private insurers provide this coverage, which can be a lifesaver in safeguarding your investment against unpredictable natural disasters. 3. Earthquake Insurance Similar to flood insurance, earthquake insurance is a must-have if you live in an area prone to earthquakes. This coverage helps repair or rebuild your home and replace personal belongings in the
title: Top 5 Insurance Coverage for Homeowners | DarGlobal

This coverage helps repair or rebuild your home and replace personal belongings in the event of an earthquake. Considering the devastating impact an earthquake can have, this insurance provides essential financial protection. 4. Umbrella Liability Insurance Umbrella liability insurance provides additional liability coverage beyond what your standard homeowners insurance offers. It protects your assets and future earnings in case you’re sued for damages that exceed the liability limits of your other insurance policies.
